evidence_boundary: This inventory distinguishes discovered artifacts, hash-bound source material, execution traces, generated tasks, manuscripts, reported aggregate claims, and exact AutoLabOS confirmatory admission. Public availability or large trace counts do not establish a clean benchmark base. Only an exact admission backed by source-grounded readiness evidence, repeated trials, comparison results, figure and claim-evidence checks, license review, two independent human normalizations, and diversity-preserving intake can enter the confirmatory suite.
